name: io.github.umayado17/nas-search-mcp
title: Synology NAS search
description: Search a Synology NAS's Universal Search index over SSH. No sudo, keeps DSM 2FA, read-only.

environmentVariables.name: UNISEARCH_HOST
environmentVariables.description: SSH destination of the NAS, e.g. user@nas. Can be set in ~/.config/unisearch/client.conf instead.

environmentVariables.name: UNISEARCH_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Path to the search-only SSH key. Can be set in ~/.config/unisearch/client.conf instead.

environmentVariables.name: UNISEARCH_LANG
environmentVariables.description: Language of messages: en or ja (default ja).
